title: Everything Voxy Server
description: The server side modpack for Everything Voxy
body:
**Everything Voxy Server**

[![Sparked host use code EverythingVoxy for 25% off](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/MRCodERDude/EverythingVoxy@main/Artboard_3.png)
](https://billing.sparkedhost.com/aff.php?aff=3199)

This server pack is built with one clear goal: making sure Everything Voxy works flawlessly in multiplayer. Every component in this server-side pack is focused on heavy optimization, keeping TPS high, improving chunk data delivery, and ensuring server performance stays rock-solid even when players are loading massive distances.

This pack strips away unnecessary bloat and prioritizes the backend improvements that truly matter for server responsiveness and network stability. It remains incredibly lightweight and efficient, specifically configured so the server can handle the massive render distances required by Voxy clients. This ensures your players can smoothly run their huge render distances without lagging the server.

Every configuration is tuned so the server boots faster, uses memory more efficiently, and stays completely stable even in demanding areas with multiple players exploring at once. Voxy is the core of this pack, and the entire server setup is designed specifically to support and enhance its massive scale!
